# Issue report

Please use the structured **Bug report** or **Feature request** form when one applies.

## Summary

<!-- Describe the problem, question, or proposal. -->

## Context

<!-- Include the relevant package, Pi, Node.js, and operating-system versions. -->

## Reproduction or proposal

<!--
For bugs, provide minimal reproduction steps and expected behavior.
For proposals, explain the use case, desired behavior, and alternatives.
-->

## Diagnostics

<!-- Include safe `/plugin doctor` output or logs when relevant. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and pull requests.
- [ ] I removed credentials, tokens, private URLs, and sensitive data.
- [ ] I identified whether the request concerns portable behavior or Pi policy.
